anita: Heads-up — Honeycomb edge VPC change window is scheduled for 2025-11-03 02:00 UTC. Plan: deploy connector v2.1, run DB schema update, and flip routing.

leo: Got it. I'll own the DB schema step. ETA ~15m. Will be on call during the window.

sophie: I'll do the canary routing and smoke checks. Can we add a quick list of smoke tests?

anita: yes — smoke checklist:
- ping health endpoint on connector
- confirm KV cache warm on 3 replicas
- sample generate a short prompt
- verify ingestion into internal metrics

max: I'll stand by for rollback. If DB migration >5m or errors, we rollback to v2.0 and restore DB snapshot.

sophie: smoke commands:
```bash
# health
curl -sS https://honeycomb-edge.internal/health
# quick gen
curl -sS -X POST https://honeycomb-edge.internal/gen -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

deploy-bot: scheduled deployment window created by anita for honeycomb-edge at 2025-11-03T02:00:00Z. Notifying oncall.

leo: quick Q — do we have a preflight runbook link? I couldn't find the updated steps.

anita: attaching runbook in threads — see ops-bot link.

ops-bot: runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/honeycomb-edge-deploy-v2.1 (public to team) :link:

sophie: timeline sync — 02:00 start, 02:02 deploy connector on canary, 02:07 run smoke, 02:10 scale canary→3, 02:20 full flip. Call rollback at first sign of repeated errors or perf regression >20%.

max: I'll prepare DB snapshot at 01:50 UTC and keep it available. Will post checksum once done.

leo: noted. I'll post migration dry-run logs at 01:55.

anita: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll update the calendar slot and ping customer liaison before the window. :thumbsup:
